company.name: Genentech
company.shortDescription: Genentech is a biotechnology research company that specializes in genetic testing and personalized medicines.
company.description: Genentech is a biotechnology company that discovers, develops, manufactures, and commercializes medicines to treat patients with serious or life-threatening medical conditions. It creates multiple products on the market and a development pipeline. The company became a member of the Roche Group in 2009. As part of their merger agreement, Roche and Genentech combined their pharmaceutical operations in the United States. Genentech’s South San Francisco campus now serves as the headquarters for Roche pharmaceutical operations in the United States. Genentech’s Research and Early Development section operates as an independent center within Roche.
company.headquarters: South San Francisco, California, United States

aiResearchSummary.text: Genentech is researching and developing biomarkers and methods for treating PD-1/PD-L1 related conditions, HER2-positive cancers with bispecific antibodies, and anti-steap1 antigen binding molecules for cancer therapy. Efforts include diagnostic and therapeutic methods using polygenic risk scores, anti-CD79b immunoconjugates for B-cell lymphomas, and machine learning-enabled molecular subtype classification for hepatocellular carcinoma. These areas reflect Genentech’s focus on genetic testing and personalized medicines.
